test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Her determination impressed all of the other colleagues and __inspires them to continue pursuing their__ dreams.

options.text: inspires them in continuing pursuing their
inspired them to continue pursuing their
inspires them to continue pursuing her
inspires them to continue pursuing there

solution:
The correct answer is: **Inspired them to continue pursuing their**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in the past tense ("**impressed**" and "**inspired**"),
